item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The audit has reached saturation under the authorized crash-fault model; remaining anomalies require duplicated/spoofed traffic or unsupported inputs and are recorded as out-of-scope rather than findings.

The audit remains at 28 confirmed findings. Highest-impact risks are:

- LFU cache resynchronization producing replica value divergence,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corruption,
- decided-index regression during `AcceptSync`,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The complete report, verified replay script, and retained logs are available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
